verdict.rationale: Channel3 is a product-search data API with an SDK, CLI and its own MCP server. Acting as an MCP client host that loads third-party MCP servers falls outside what this kind of product does. The evidence shows Channel3 only in the server role, with agents such as Cursor and Claude connecting to it, and its 'agentic mode' is internal LLM search planning, not pluggable tool use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
